name: Bairlasshof
beschreibung:
Overview

The Bairlasshof – also written Bairlashof on the tourism website – is a bed-and-breakfast with a holiday apartment or appartement in Sölden in the Ötztal valley in Tyrol. According to the description of the official booking portal, the establishment is located “outside Sölden” in the small hamlet of Granstein, specifically at Gransteinstraße 17, 6450 Sölden. The house therefore belongs to the municipality of Sölden in the district of Imst, and the postcode is 6450. According to the booking portal, a 4- to 6-person apartment with one bedroom is offered, as well as double rooms with running water, where the WC and shower are located inside the house. The listed amenities include a free parking space and permission for pets. Cash payment is mentioned under payment methods.

History/Background

No reliable information on the founding, age or history of the house could be found in the available sources. The entries describe the establishment objectively as a bed-and-breakfast and apartment or holiday apartment. The operator is named as Gabriela Grüner, who also acts as the contact person for bookings and enquiries. The name of the house refers to its location in the hamlet of Granstein, which lies somewhat outside the actual centre of Sölden. Since no further historical evidence is available, this section deliberately remains neutral and is limited to the documented details.

Arrival

Sölden is located in the rear Ötztal valley and can be reached via the Inntal Autobahn (A12) and the Ötztalstraße (B186), which leads from the Ötztal motorway exit into the town. By train, you travel to Ötztal station and from there continue by bus into the valley to Sölden. Locally, the paths in the Granstein district lead to the Gransteinstraße; according to the amenities information, a free parking space is available at the Bairlasshof. For the specific access route and arrival arrangements, it is advisable to contact the house in advance.

Tips

Important for planning is the local tax (Ortstaxe): it is not included in the stated total price and is charged directly by the host; the accommodation states EUR 5.00 per person per night. According to the information provided, children and young people are exempt from the local tax up to the end of the calendar year in which they turn 15. Questions about availability, room preferences and arrival can be clarified by telephone at +43 5254 30440 or by email. Since rooms with running water are offered and the WC and shower are located inside the house, it is worth agreeing on the desired room category in advance. Pets are welcome, a free parking space is available; cash payment is stated as the payment method.

Best time to travel

Year-round use is typical for the Sölden region: the winter season in the ski area generally runs from about December to April, while hiking and cycling tours are possible in the summer months from June to September. Specific season dates or opening hours relating to the establishment were not stated in the sources and are therefore not mentioned here.
